summary: Practise WaterGEMS network setup, simulation, calibration, and fire-flow analysis. Review the 10-day intermediate course outline.
lede: Water distribution hydraulic modeling uses WaterGEMS to configure network data and assess pressure, flow, demand, and operating scenarios. For hydraulic modelers, network engineers, and utility operations staff, the course covers checking connectivity and inputs, allocating demand, running simulations, and comparing scenarios. You also practise calibration, fire-flow and pressure-zone assessment, and reporting assumptions and results to inform operations or upgrade decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who build, maintain, validate, or use water-distribution hydraulic models in utility and industrial network settings.
audience: Utility asset management specialists using hydraulic results
prerequisites: Working knowledge of water-distribution networks, pipe flow, pressure, and pump operation is expected. WaterGEMS experience is helpful; programming is not required. Bring a laptop with WaterGEMS installed and confirm compatible version and licensed access before training.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
